title: Farsea Marshwine
summary: Contributes 1 Camp Supplies to Long Rest, or can be drunk as a Bonus Action.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle to gain Alcohol for 2 turns, imposing disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Throw: Action. Break the bottle to create a permanent 13 ft-radius Alcohol surface. Alcohol is flammable and can freeze.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
